university.name: Queen Mary University of London
university.summary: A university in east London with a main campus at Mile End. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate taught and research degrees, has a Pakistan entry requirements page listing in-country representatives, and offers international foundation routes.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: A three-year honours degree covering programming, computer systems and networks, logic and discrete structures, and professional and research practice. Foundation, industrial experience and year abroad variants are listed separately.
courses.academic_requirements: A-level AAA including one of Mathematics, Computer Science or Physics, or International Baccalaureate Diploma with 36 points including 6,6,6 at Higher Level.
courses.english_requirements: School of Electronic Engineering and Computer Science undergraduate level, Band 3: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with 5.5 in each component, or PTE Academic 65 overall with 59 in each component. TOEFL iBT accepted at a published level on either scale.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Direct entry to undergraduate degrees is considered on A-levels or the International Baccalaureate, and recognised foundation qualifications may also be considered. The Pakistan page lists no grades or percentages for undergraduate entry.
courses.notes: English figures come from the university's English language requirements page (band by school) and accepted tests page; the course page itself lists no scores. TOEFL left null because the university publishes two different scales depending on test date.

courses.title: Law
courses.overview: A three-year qualifying law degree whose first year covers public law, land law, contract law and European Union law. Variants with business, politics and other subjects are listed separately.
highlights: Contract Law I: Formation and Vitiation
courses.academic_requirements: A-level A*AA, or International Baccalaureate Diploma with 36 points including 6,6,6 at Higher Level. Contextual offers are listed as standard AAA and enhanced ABB.
courses.english_requirements: School of Law non-standard requirement for all undergraduate programmes: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with 6.5 in Writing and 5.5 in Listening, Reading and Speaking.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Direct entry to undergraduate degrees is considered on A-levels or the International Baccalaureate, and recognised foundation qualifications may also be considered. The Pakistan page lists no grades or percentages for undergraduate entry.
courses.notes: The course page shows the fee beside the September 2027 entry year without labelling it, so 2027/28 is inferred. The English requirement comes from the non-standard requirements page, which names School of Law undergraduate programmes generally, not the LLB by name.

courses.title: Business Management
courses.overview: A three-year business degree whose first year includes corporate strategy and social justice, economic thinking with data, managing for success, and marketing principles with artificial intelligence applications. Several variants are listed on the page.
courses.academic_requirements: A-level AAA, or International Baccalaureate Diploma with 36 points including 6,6,6 at Higher Level and at least 4 in Standard Level Mathematics. Contextual offers are listed as standard ABB and enhanced BBB.
courses.english_requirements: School of Business and Management undergraduate level, Band 4: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component, or PTE Academic 71 overall with 65 in each component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Direct entry to undergraduate degrees is considered on A-levels or the International Baccalaureate, and recognised foundation qualifications may also be considered. The Pakistan page lists no grades or percentages for undergraduate entry.
courses.notes: The course page shows the fee beside the September 2027 entry year without labelling it, so 2027/28 is inferred. UCAS code NN12 for the main programme. English figures come from the university's band table and accepted tests page.

courses.title: Biomedical Sciences
courses.overview: A three-year honours degree on the biology of the human body in health and disease, with first-year modules on physiology, biomolecules, cells and scientific skills. Foundation and year abroad variants are listed separately.
courses.academic_requirements: A-level AAB including Biology plus a second science from Chemistry, Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Physics or Psychology, or International Baccalaureate Diploma with 34 points including 6,6,5 at Higher Level with Biology and a second science.
courses.english_requirements: School of Biological and Behavioural Sciences undergraduate level, Band 3: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with 5.5 in each component, or PTE Academic 65 overall with 59 in each component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Direct entry to undergraduate degrees is considered on A-levels or the International Baccalaureate, and recognised foundation qualifications may also be considered. The Pakistan page lists no grades or percentages for undergraduate entry.
courses.notes: UCAS code B990. English figures come from the university's band table and accepted tests page.

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering
courses.overview: A three-year engineering degree whose first year covers engineering design, experimental design and practice, computational and mathematical modelling, and materials engineering. MEng and placement variants are listed with their own requirements.
courses.academic_requirements: A-level AAB including Mathematics and Physics or Chemistry, or International Baccalaureate Diploma with 34 points including 6,6,5 at Higher Level, with Higher Level Mathematics and Physics or Chemistry.
courses.english_requirements: School of Engineering and Materials Science undergraduate level, Band 3: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with 5.5 in each component, or PTE Academic 65 overall with 59 in each component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Direct entry to undergraduate degrees is considered on A-levels or the International Baccalaureate, and recognised foundation qualifications may also be considered. The Pakistan page lists no grades or percentages for undergraduate entry.
courses.notes: UCAS code H300. The course page does not label the fee year beyond the September 2027 entry; the fee is stated for entry starting September 2027.

courses.title: Advanced Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 1 year full time (2 years part time also offered)
courses.overview: A one-year master's for graduates in computing and related subjects, with core modules including functional programming, security and authentication, interactive system design and cloud computing.
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:1 or above in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics or a related discipline. Applicants with a good 2:2 (55% or above) are considered individually.
courses.english_requirements: Band 4: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each of Writing, Listening, Reading and Speaking, or PTE Academic 71 overall with 65 in each component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Postgraduate taught entry is from a bachelor degree of minimum 4 years from selected institutions. The page gives GPA guidance out of 4.0 (UK 2:1 equivalent GPA 2.6 to 3.6) and states that offer conditions vary by the applicant's institution; no percentages are listed.
courses.notes: Full time fee for September 2027 entry; the part time fee is GBP 18,450 per year for 2 years. The 4 year bachelor requirement is read as the 16-year route; the page does not use that term.

courses.title: Laws
courses.duration_text: 1 year full time (2 years part time also offered)
courses.overview: A one-year master's in law with a choice of specialist areas and a study option that includes SQE preparation at a higher fee. Module choices are listed on a separate page.
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:1 or above in Law or a degree with substantial law content. Law graduates with a 2:2 may qualify with other legal qualifications or substantial professional legal experience.
courses.english_requirements: School of Law non-standard requirement for all postgraduate taught programmes: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with 6.5 in Writing and 6.0 in Listening, Reading and Speaking.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Postgraduate taught entry is from a bachelor degree of minimum 4 years from selected institutions. The page gives GPA guidance out of 4.0 (UK 2:1 equivalent GPA 2.6 to 3.6) and states that offer conditions vary by the applicant's institution; no percentages are listed.
courses.notes: Fee shown is the full time September 2027 fee; the SQE preparation option costs GBP 39,500 for September 2027. Some study options start in January 2027. Module list was not on the page, so highlights are empty. The English requirement comes from the non-standard requirements page, which names School of Law postgraduate taught programmes generally, not the LLM by name.

scholarships.name: Global Talent Scholarship (Undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: Up to GBP 20,000: GBP 5,000 per academic year over a standard four-year degree, renewable yearly with an average of 65% or above
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition award for international undergraduate offer holders for September 2027 whose final grades exceed their offer by one grade level. There is no application. Several programmes and foundation routes are excluded.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer for an eligible undergraduate programme starting September 2027; overseas fee status; self-funded and full time; achieve one grade above the standard offer (for example A*AA for an AAA offer); no other Queen Mary scholarship or discount.
scholarships.deadline_note: No application or deadline; awards cannot be deferred. Excluded: BSc Accountancy, LLB English and French Law, dentistry, dental therapy and hygiene, medicine, degree apprenticeships, foundation programmes, study abroad and year two entry.
scholarships.notes: The page lists the country as All and does not name Pakistan; eligibility depends on overseas fee status. The first GBP 5,000 is deducted from tuition at enrolment.

scholarships.name: Global Excellence Scholarship (Postgraduate Taught)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 8,000 deducted from tuition fees on enrolment
scholarships.summary: A tuition award for international offer holders on eligible full time master's programmes for September 2027 with a first-class honours degree or overseas equivalent. Applicants complete a form emailed when applications open; one form covers three Global scholarships.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer for an eligible postgraduate taught programme; minimum UK first class honours or overseas equivalent; overseas fee status; full time master's; self-funded; no other University or full-fee scholarship.
scholarships.deadline_note: Allocated on a rolling basis; applications open October 2026; unlimited awards until April 2027. Excludes MRes, PG Diploma, PG Certificate, distance learning, pre-masters and some named programmes including MSc Economics.
scholarships.notes: The page lists the country as All and does not name Pakistan; the page text on opening is ambiguous (Oct 26) and is read as October 2026.

scholarships.name: Global Talent Scholarship (Postgraduate Taught)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 6,000 deducted from tuition fees on enrolment
scholarships.summary: A tuition award for international offer holders on eligible full time master's programmes for September 2027 with a 2:1 honours degree or overseas equivalent. Applicants complete a form emailed when applications open.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer for an eligible postgraduate taught programme; minimum UK 2:1 honours or overseas equivalent; overseas fee status; full time; self-funded; no other University or full-fee scholarship.
scholarships.deadline_note: Allocated on a rolling basis; applications open October 2026; unlimited awards until April 2027. Excludes MRes, PG Diploma, PG Certificate, distance learning, pre-masters and some named programmes including MSc Economics and MSc Global Public Health and Policy.
scholarships.notes: The page is internally inconsistent on the intake (September 2027, September 2026/7 and 2027/28); September 2027 is used from the title. The overview page lists the award as up to GBP 8,000 while this page states GBP 6,000; the page figure is used.

scholarships.name: Global Merit Scholarship (Postgraduate Taught)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 deducted from tuition fees on enrolment
scholarships.summary: A tuition award for international offer holders on eligible full time master's programmes for September 2027 with at least a high 2:2 honours degree or overseas equivalent. Applicants complete a form emailed when applications open.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer for an eligible postgraduate taught programme; minimum UK high 2:2 honours degree or overseas equivalent; overseas fee status; full time; self-funded; no other University or full-fee scholarship.
scholarships.deadline_note: Allocated on a rolling basis; applications open October 2026; unlimited awards until April 2027. Excludes MRes, PG Diploma, PG Certificate, distance learning, pre-masters and some named programmes including MSc Economics.
scholarships.notes: The overview page lists the award as up to GBP 8,000 while this page states GBP 5,000; the page figure is used. The page also refers to 2027/8 in one place.
